newsitem.title: UK: Laura Ashley to halt U.S. expansion - report.
newsitem.headline: Laura Ashley to halt U.S. expansion - report.

text.p: British fashion and textiles group Laura Ashley Plc may announce a halt to its expansion in the U.S., the Times newspaper said in its Thursday edition.
No-one at the company was immediately available for comment.
The Times said that the company was also expected to announce job cuts at its factories in Wales when it makes a trading update next week.
The newspaper said that analysts felt poor trading in new stores opened in the U.S. had persuaded the company to abandon all new openings apart from those to which it is already firmly committed.

The group, made famous by its floral dresses and taffeta party frocks, has been struggling to turn around its fortunes under the leadership of Ann Iverson, the American chief executive appointed two years ago.
Iverson, who is credited with turning around British childrenswear chain Mothercare, has come under increasing pressure after Laura Ashley issued a profit warning in April.
